title: Roomful Of Blues - I`m Just Your Fool

lines.l: Why, I love you so, you ain't no good, should let you go, no I ain't jiving, no need a lying, I'm just a fool.
You must be trying to drive me crazy You're treating me the way you do
I beg you please help myself, baby Oh, and let me be happy too
For if you leave me, for someone new
I'll buy a shotgun, shoot dead at you
No, I ain't jiving, no need to lying
You must be trying to drive me crazy
Treat me the way you do
I beg you please have mercy baby
Oh and let me be happy too
No, I ain't jivin', no, you ain't lyin', I'm just your fool.
